five_hour_flow.visual_consistency: Farm, glowing-forest battle, parchment rewards, and illustrated dungeon nodes now share a warm storybook fantasy language.
five_hour_flow.cheap_web_ui: Core release path uses illustrated assets and parchment/gold framing; emoji fallback and flat-color map tiles were removed from formal UI.
five_hour_flow.long_term_goal: Land quality produces higher-quality materials and cards; high-quality cards now affect expedition reward choices, feeding beasts, workshop and farm progression.
five_hour_flow.reward_peak: A 0.92-quality crafted card triggers explicit rare-origin resonance copy and the exclusive 丰饶回响 reward.
five_hour_flow.fatigue_risks: Persistent HUD density, mobile text density and dark dungeon repetition remain P1 polish items, not P0 release blockers.
